description: Public Airport is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Caltrans. This is a point layer of Public Use Airports currently permitted by the State of California, Department of Transportation (Caltrans), Division of Transportation Planning Aeronautics Program. Details for each site are updated regularly after airport permit safety inspections of each site. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher Caltrans. Its tags are Airport, Aviation, CAOpenData, CalSTA, California. It offers 7 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
